name: Jurisdicción de Lara (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, red and white with a broad red middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jurisdicción de Lara (cauldrons, an eagle and a castle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Jurisdicción de Lara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Jurisdicción de Lara arms — cauldrons, eagle and castle
